title: OneLink
tagline: One link to create a own customizable landing page with links and services to their various online platforms and resources with cool features.
description:
Features
Dedicated custom Social media link
100-125 character Bio
Profile picture/ GIF, NFT supported
Web3 domain links 
NFT gallery 
Web3 brave meeting integration
Meeting booking and management (just like calendly)
Support for multi chain wallets
Blog Links 
External
Paid (premium services)
Customizable Enquiry form/contact 
Send funds (Metamask integration) to another wallet supports multichain
Password based notes 
Payment based sections
Save profiles by category (e.g friends, colleagues, marketing, VC etc)
Visitors count (analytics) Details stats using google analytics
Showcase Portfolio / Private public 
File storage using third party web3 based
Company data showcase like pricing total volume, rank on cmc, mcap etc
Show some features when the wallet is connected while showing the public when the wallet is not connected at viewers end.
how_its_made: It is build by my team mate in multiple technologies in backend it connects meta mask and reads the addressee to maintain the data. most of the component are made by very care as a time lacks we aren't able to complete the project within time frame. we are adding three dashboard one for user and second for admin which will have majority of features to control the features, third dashboard is for analytics to show how project is performing and getting insights of the project features to help improve offerings to the users
